title: GTA 6: Last to 2nd in 3.47 Seconds 🏁
youtube_description:
GTA 6: last to second in under three and a half seconds. In Rockstar's An Extended Look (at 20:21), a race at sunset shows its HUD in the corner: the shot opens at 6 of 6 with its timer at 00:04.79, and by 00:08.26 it reads 2 of 6. In between it ticks 5, 4, 3, 2, and PROGRESS still says only 10%. That race sits in a run of night shots (20:14 to 20:34): a tower lit purple, a selfie by the Hotel Dixon sign, a pool party, the race, a packed dance floor, a balcony where the button prompt reads Drink and Drop, and two more city shots after it. Rockstar says the Extended Look was "captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5".

Pool party, dance floor or a race from last place: where are you spending your first night in Vice City?

Sources (Rockstar Games, read Nov 25, 2026):
- Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, August 27, 2026, 20:14 to 20:34 ("Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5"): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

Every HUD value in this Short was read frame by frame off Rockstar's video; 3.47 s is 00:08.26 minus 00:04.79 on the HUD's own timer. The timer readout, the leaderboard, the progress track, the timeline strip and the vote are our own graphics; the hook plays the race shot at 3.3x speed (labelled); the zoomed HUD and prompt are Rockstar's own frames, enlarged. We don't know whether this race is a side activity or a story mission, or how it ends.

Clips: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look), used for commentary. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
